steps.content: Eastside is as busy as always. You follow Doyle down the road, with the two Sinners trailing not far behind.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Ambrosia... Ambrosia... Why didn't that **** scoundrel Gandall mention it earlier...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Dr. Gandall really wants to help you get back on your feet.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Yeah, right! He should mind his own business. He just wants to laugh at me!
Talking about his old friend will just trigger him further, so you change the subject.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: I don't know. The name sounds familiar. I must have heard it somewhere recently... But I just can't ******* remember!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's go back to where we met first.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let's go back to the back door of Midsummer Night's Club. There were two Sleepwalkers next to you at the time. They must have taken Ambrosia to become like that.

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Who's the inspector, you or me? Come!

Seeing that this guy is still being foolish, you sigh and consider contacting Nightingale to investigate the two "Sleepwalkers" who attacked you, or to ask the 9th Agency to get you the footage from nearby surveillance cameras.
At that moment, a thin, black scrap gets blown in front of you. The wind flips it 90 degrees in the air, and you see that it's a strange figure resembling a four-leaf clover.

steps.speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
steps.content: Want to become a good luck charm?

steps.speaker: Black Four-leaf Clover
steps.content: Take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all take it all!!!

steps.speaker: Doyle
steps.content: Black goo? There are Sleepwalkers nearby!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, remain undercover, don't expose yourself...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh? Remain undercover?! We're already fighting in the middle of the **** street!
